title: UNION-Based Extraction on Vintage Vinyl Store
learning_objectives: Recognise UNION-based SQL injection in a single-quoted WHERE clause
Determine the required column count and datatypes for a UNION SELECT
Use verbose database errors to enumerate column count and types
Exfiltrate a value from a second table (admin_notes) and submit it to win
flag_hint: /solve compares ?token to admin_notes.secret; on match it returns the flag read from the flag file, otherwise HTTP 403.
inspired_by: PortSwigger 'SQL injection UNION attack, determining the number of columns' + classic error-based MySQL extraction patterns
